g.text: Timing at 24 fps. Each cell is one frame, and a filled cell is a new drawing.
camera always uses the true time t
grey = held drawing. K1 hold 8, anticipation 6, accent and smear 4, overshoot 4, settle 4, K2 hold 18
half 1, closed 2, half 2 (opening is slower). Then back on 2s.
eyes lead by 2 frames, then F, ib, ¾, ib, P on 2s; hair follows 2 frames late
single-frame visemes merge into the previous one. A (M/B/P) is never dropped. Shift the mouth 1 frame earlier than the audio.
Holds: minimum 6 frames to read any pose, 12–24 frames for an acting key, 24–72 frames for a listening hold (with a blink plus 2–4 px of drift).

Anticipation 3–8 frames at 10–20% of the action in reverse. Overshoot 2–4 frames at 8–15% past, then settle over 4–6 frames. Smear or multiples: 1–2 frames, only when the move is over 120 px in 3 frames or fewer.
Stagger: no two characters start a move on the same frame (at least 4 frames apart). Within a body: head 0, torso +2, arms +4, hand settle +6.
